description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain with a location in Chilliwack, notable for its commitment to quality ingredients: dough made fresh in-house from 100% Canadian wheat, organic tomato sauce, and meats raised without antibiotics. The menu spans pizzas, salads, sides, dips, and beverages, with a strong emphasis on plant-based and meat-free choices. Touring cyclists can call ahead or order online for pickup.
